## Upgrade Steps

- **Step 1: Setup Environment & Verify Configuration**
  - **Rationale**: Verify Java 25 environment is ready and confirm Maven Wrapper compatibility before baseline setup.
  - **Changes to Make**:
    - [ ] Confirm JDK 25.0.1 is installed and accessible
    - [ ] Verify Maven Wrapper 3.9.14 is executable
    - [ ] Set JAVA_HOME environment variable to Java 25 path
  - **Verification**:
    - Command: `mvnw --version` and `java -version`
    - Expected: Output confirms Maven 3.9.14 and Java 25.0.1

---

- **Step 2: Setup Baseline - Compile & Test with Current Java (17)**
  - **Rationale**: Establish baseline compile/test results with Java 17 to measure upgrade success.
  - **Changes to Make**:
    - [ ] Switch to Java 17 (SDKMAN current)
    - [ ] Run clean compile (main + test code)
    - [ ] Run full test suite
    - [ ] Document test pass rate and any failures
  - **Verification**:
    - Command: `mvnw clean test-compile` then `mvnw clean test`
    - JDK: Java 17 (SDKMAN)
    - Expected: Document baseline results (pass rate, failure count if any)

---

- **Step 3: Upgrade to Java 25 & Configure Compiler Target**
  - **Rationale**: Switch runtime to Java 25 and explicitly configure Maven compiler to target Java 25.
  - **Changes to Make**:
    - [ ] Update `pom.xml`: add/update `<maven.compiler.source>25</maven.compiler.source>`
    - [ ] Update `pom.xml`: add/update `<maven.compiler.target>25</maven.compiler.target>`
    - [ ] Update `pom.xml`: add/update `<maven.compiler.release>25</maven.compiler.release>` (preferred)
    - [ ] Set JAVA_HOME to Java 25
    - [ ] Clean compile (main + test code)
  - **Verification**:
    - Command: `mvnw clean test-compile`
    - JDK: Java 25.0.1
    - Expected: Compilation SUCCESS with Java 25

---

- **Step 4: Final Validation - Full Test Suite with Java 25**
  - **Rationale**: Verify all upgrade goals met and all tests pass with Java 25 runtime.
  - **Changes to Make**:
    - [ ] Ensure JAVA_HOME is set to Java 25
    - [ ] Run clean rebuild with full test suite
    - [ ] Fix any compilation errors immediately
    - [ ] Fix any test failures iteratively (100% pass rate required)
  - **Verification**:
    - Command: `mvnw clean verify` (or `mvnw clean test` for quick check)
    - JDK: Java 25.0.1
    - Expected: Compilation SUCCESS + 100% test pass rate

---
